moments.title: In 2015, a Virginia jury awarded $500,000 to a patient whose phone accidentally recorded his medical team while he was under sedation. He had intended to record his doctor’s post-procedure instructions, but the recording
moments.selftext: In 2015, a Virginia jury awarded $500,000 to a patient whose phone accidentally recorded his medical team while he was under sedation. He had intended to record his doctor’s post-procedure instructions, but the recording captured anesthesiologist Tiffany Ingham and gastroenterologist Soloman Shah making disparaging remarks about him. The audio reportedly included insults about his intelligence, a false claim that he had syphilis, and comments about avoiding him after the procedure. The case ultimately resulted in an award for defamation, medical malpractice, and punitive damages.

moments.selftext: We’ve written an FAQ to answer some of the questions we've received about watermarking. In summary: • We’re implementing watermarking to comply with the EU AI Act. Other major model developers have signed the same Code of Practice and will also be implementing watermarking; • Our watermarking method doesn’t have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs; • The difference between watermarked and un-watermarked text will not be distinguishable to readers; • Nothing is added to the text and there are no hidden characters; • Watermarking doesn’t require extra tokens, and will not be more expensive; • Watermarks can’t be traced to a specific person, organization, or chat.
